definitions.gloss: first shrine/temple visit of the new year
definitions.explanation: The traditional practice of visiting a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple for the first time in the new year.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go for the first shrine visit of the year.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}→願い事：14621_negaigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a wish for this year at the new year shrine visit.

examples.english: Meiji Shrine gets crowded during hatsumode.

notes:
{初詣|はつもうで} is the first shrine or temple visit of the new year, one of Japan's most important New Year traditions.

TIMING:
Most people go between New Year's Eve midnight and January 3rd (⟦{三|さん}が{日|にち}→三が日：16219_sanganichi⟧). The most crowded time is midnight on New Year's Eve.

ACTIVITIES:
- ⟦お{参|まい}りする→お参り：16837_omairi⟧: to pray/pay respects
- ⟦おみくじ→御神籤：05959_omikuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a fortune slip
- ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a protective charm
- ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write wishes on wooden plaques
- ⟦{甘酒|あまざけ}→甘酒：13519_amazake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink sweet sake

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {初詣|はつもうで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go for hatsumode
- {初詣|はつもうで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}→願い事：14621_negaigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a New Year wish

USAGE:
People may visit either Shinto shrines (⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧) or Buddhist temples (⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧).
